# Seeker Solutions

> Seeker Solutions LLC helps people find clarity, meaning and direction as AI reshapes work, and helps the teachers, meditation centers and small organizations who serve them use AI and automation well. Tagline: "Meaning in the machine age." Based in Louisiana, USA; works remotely.

The work draws on formal training in philosophy and religious studies and more than 25 years of contemplative practice across Buddhist, Advaita Vedanta and Kashmir Shaivite traditions, plus practical experience in hospitality operations and IT. It is not therapy, medical care or manifestation coaching.

## Offers

- [The Seeker's Path Workbook](https://seekersolutions.org/#join): a self-paced contemplative training in 13 modules across five stages (Seeing, Recognizing, Descending, Widening, Embodying). Each module pairs a plain-language teaching with a daily practice, an integration step and a written checkpoint. Self-paced: most people take 13 to 26 weeks. Launch price $37.
- [The Clarity Intensive](https://seekersolutions.org/#clarity): three 75-minute one-on-one sessions over two to three weeks for someone in a genuine life transition, with integration notes and email support between sessions. $297.
- [The AI Audit](https://seekersolutions.org/#audit): for teachers, centers and small organizations. A recorded 60-minute discovery call, workflow mapping, a written report of prioritized AI and automation recommendations, and a 30-minute follow-up. Flat fee $497, no ongoing commitment.
- [Sponsored copies](https://seekersolutions.org/#sponsor): anyone who can't afford the workbook can request a free sponsored copy, no proof required. Buyers can sponsor a seat for someone on the waiting list.
- [The Threshold Assessment](https://seekersolutions.org/#assessment): a free eight-question reflection on where someone stands in a transition and what support would help. Results appear instantly; no email required. Not a diagnosis.

## Who it is for

- People questioning their work, identity or purpose as AI changes what work means
- Spiritual seekers who want rigorous, tradition-grounded practice without dogma
- Meditation teachers, retreat centers and small mission-driven organizations deciding where AI fits
